part3_scheduler_architecture.reasoning: operation_scheduler.py (pid 35375) is an already-running, complex, actively-used production daemon with its own intricate pressure/batching logic. Modifying its --loop main dispatch to add a new job type risked destabilizing a live process for a change that doesn't require sharing its runtime. The new runner follows the SAME established idioms (single-instance lock file with stale-lock recovery, --once/--status flags, quiet mode, run logging) so it fits the existing operational pattern without touching live code.
